== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ラルティア</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
'''Light''' — <span lang="ja">「タンティヴIV」はここで戦闘力＋1。</span>

'''Dark''' — <span lang="ja">「デヴァステイター」は戦闘力に＋1、またこの星系から、あるいはこの星系への移動に際してフォースを消費しない。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Ralltiir]].

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — The printed game-text box is blank.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Dark text says Devastator spends no Force moving to or from this system. English says it may move to or from here for free. Light Force icons are 0; Dark Force icons are 1.<ref>[[:File:ANH-L-ralltiir.gif|Original English face]], [[Ralltiir]].</ref>
